stories.title: Aircraft manufacturer breached Strategic Export Controls
stories.summary: Airbus Operations Limited has paid a record £6.4 million compound settlement after breaching UK strategic export controls.

stories.title: Deadline approaches for first Making Tax Digital quarterly update
stories.summary: Making Tax Digital for Income Tax customers have 2 weeks to submit their first quarterly update.

stories.title: Circular 011/2026: Annexes F, U and DA, Police Regulations 2003
stories.summary: Amendments implementing the 2025-26 police pay award, extending targeted payments, and revising unsatisfactory performance procedures.

stories.title: Police misconduct processes to be reviewed
stories.summary: Oversight of police misconduct procedures is to be reviewed as part of a wider overhaul of policing standards.

stories.title: Statement: situation in the West Bank
stories.summary: Minister Doughty issued a statement on escalating violence in the West Bank.

stories.title: Joint Statement by UK and France on Wildfires and Action on Climate Change
stories.summary: The UK and France committed to strengthening cooperation on climate-related risks including wildfires, and called for greater international climate action.

stories.title: Drought declared in half of England
stories.summary: Seven areas of England are now officially in drought after record low rainfall and exceptionally high temperatures.

stories.title: Appointment made to the Marine Management Organisation Board
stories.summary: Marsha Ramroop has been confirmed as a new board member.

stories.title: Major £8.4bn investment advances UK nuclear deterrent and backs British industry
stories.summary: Major new investment will progress the next generation of nuclear deterrent submarines, keeping the UK safe for decades and supporting British industry.

stories.title: Funding boost for British companies to supercharge UK munitions production
stories.summary: 22 companies, including British SMEs, will receive contracts worth up to £300,000 each for feasibility studies on new UK energetics manufacturing sites.

stories.title: Gemma Stevenson appointed as HMTC for Middle East & Pakistan
stories.summary: Gemma Stevenson has been appointed His Majesty's Trade Commissioner for the Middle East and Pakistan, and Consul General to Dubai and the Northern Emirates.

stories.title: NHS inviting 500,000 men to join major prostate cancer research programme
stories.summary: The NHS will begin contacting half a million men this week to join a research programme aimed at improving early detection and treatment of prostate cancer.
